faqs.a: Cloud-based patient engagement platform combining eFax, telehealth, secure messaging, intake forms, appointment reminders, and a patient portal. Designed for small to medium practices. 470,000+ users, primarily small practices and medical offices.

Standard bundle: $49-99/user/month depending on features and EHR integration. Enterprise bundle: up to $4,900/month for high-volume practices (10,000 fax pages, 500 telehealth sessions). Standalone telehealth: $50/provider/year with annual commitment, or month-to-month available.
Yes. eFax is a core feature—replaces traditional fax machines with cloud-based sending/receiving/storage. Standard tier includes up to 1,000 pages, enterprise tier up to 10,000 pages.
Web-based video chat—no apps to download. HIPAA-compliant with secure texting. Simple setup. Standard tier typically includes ~75 sessions/month, enterprise tier 500 sessions.
